name: lingux-site
description: Site web service: SPA hosting, SQLite sessions and the in-process Myanmar parser queue
author: KaungMyatThu
comment:install: Self-contained web layer. The parser's heavy libraries (pdfjs-dist, @napi-rs/canvas, harfbuzzjs, mammoth, tesseract.js) are declared in Parser/main/parser/package.json and loaded lazily through the Manager, so booting this service does not require them. Node resolves them from the parser folder when a parse actually runs.
